name: Identity & Access Management Audit Filters
description: Filter schema for IAM audit events. Demonstrates cascading based on user role and authentication method.

fields.label: User Role
fields.nl_hint: The role of the user who performed the action

fields.label: Success Status
fields.nl_hint: Whether the authentication or action was successful or failed

dependent_fields.label: Admin Scope
dependent_fields.nl_hint: The scope or level of admin privileges

dependent_fields.label: MFA Type
dependent_fields.nl_hint: The type of multi-factor authentication used

dependent_fields.label: Failure Reason
dependent_fields.nl_hint: Why the authentication or action failed

example_queries: Failed admin logins from last week
Successful MFA logins using hardware keys yesterday
Service account authentications via API key in the past 24 hours
Account lockouts for guest users this month
